messages:
sam: quick ask — can someone run the 4k/paged-attn harness with the fused-op kernels on p4d? noticed a 10-15% p99 regression on the canary runs this morning. :eyes:
anya: I can run it. which branch/commit and exact config?
sam: branch feat/paged-fuse-opt, commit abc1234. config: batch_size=1, seq_len=4096, kv_cache_paged=true, use_flash=true, quant=fp16. run command:```scripts/bench/run_inference.sh --model rwbig --bs 1 --seq 4096 --paged --fused_ops --commit abc1234```
miguel: starting a run on p4d-8x this slot (us-west2). will use isolate node rn-34.
perf-bot: baseline (main@2026-03-10) vs canary (feat/paged-fuse-opt): p99 +12% on 4096 seq (summary link: https://perf.internal/runs/4532)
olivia: fwiw I saw a mem spike in the staging run earlier, maybe the new fused_matmul mmap path increases transient allocations. can someone grep dmesg + driver logs?
cheng: flagged one change in the kernel patch: we added an extra memcpy for tiled->contig in fused_matmul to satisfy alignment. cheap compute but extra copies. could explain latency/mem.
anya: run started 1862340320, ETA ~25m. I'll capture nsys profile and flamegraphs. command I'm using:```nsys profile -o /tmp/run_4096 -t cuda,osrt python bench/harness.py --config cfg/paged_fuse.yaml```
miguel: first run finished, attaching tail of stdout:
```
[2026-03-17 14:12:41] INFO tokens: 4096, iter:1, latency_ms: 1420
[2026-03-17 14:12:42] INFO iter:2, latency_ms: 1388
[2026-03-17 14:12:43] INFO iter:3, latency_ms: 1405
```
sam: those latencies match the regression direction. any chance to flip the memcpy to use gpuMemcpyAsync or fuse the copy into the kernel?
cheng: can try async memcpy or inline copy in the kernel, but needs careful sync of streams and KV cache offsets. I'll prototype a patch today.
olivia: pinging @sam for PR review once cheng posts a draft — PR #4527?
sam: yep that's the one. I'll prioritize review. thanks everyone, please drop links to profiles/results here when ready. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: run summary (1862340600): p50 720ms -> 730ms, p95 1100ms -> 1250ms, p99 1320ms -> 1468ms, mem peak +1.8GB. full diff: https://perf.internal/compare/4532/4533
anya: uploaded nsys and flamegraphs to the run folder: https://storage.internal/paged-fuse/1862340320/
miguel: added job log + environment: cuda 12.2, driver 535.86, cuDNN 9.2
sam: cool. next steps: cheng protos kernel copy, anya will re-run with async memcpy toggle, miguel will reproduce on a second p4d node, olivia will check driver/dmesg anomalies. we'll sync up in RFC thread if results are inconclusive.
olivia: noted, thanks.
sam: thanks all. close loop later.
